Wrote software to parse and visualize mass spectroscopy data.

positions.title: CSSI Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
•	Individually: Designed and deployed an automatically generated site to showcase photographs and life events utilizing Python, Javascript, HTML, Google AppEngine and Datastore.
•	In a group of 3: Led back-end development of web-app which utilized Geolocation API and Google Places API to calculate the midpoint between users and serve activities in the area.
•	Website received a 95 on performance in Google’s Lighthouse benchmark.

positions.title: Systems Developer
positions.description:
•	In a group of 3: Led the low-level development and fabrication of an infrared controlled Raspberry Pi Pandora internet radio.
•	Linked Python, Pandora API, and Linux LIRC libraries to create smart-radio software.
•	Utilized computer aided design, rapid prototyping, and fabrication technologies in UCI’s FABWorks Lab.
